recipes.title: Nana's Pa Dutch Potato and Bread Filling
recipes.description: This is my Nana's mother's recipe, which was probably her mother's (who only spoke Pa-German). Nana made this every holiday with turkey and ham. It's a bit of work, but well worth it. Nana always made it the day before and baked it the day of eating it.
recipes.search: nana's pa dutch potato and bread filling potato 5 lbs potatoes, scrubbed, peeled and cut up 4 tablespoons butter 1 ½ cups milk 1 cup chicken stock ¾ cup butter (1 ½ sticks) 3 cups finely chopped celery (use the leaves also) 2 cups finely chopped sweet onions ¼ cup chopped fresh parsley ½ teaspoon salt (or more to taste) ½ teaspoon pepper 7-8 slices toasted white bread, cut into small cubes 3 eggs, beaten

recipes.title: Mississippi Pot Roast {The BEST EVER Pot Roast}
recipes.description: This Mississippi Pot Roast is the most delicious pot roast you will EVER eat! Made with just five simple ingredients and slow cooked in the crockpot, you are going to fall in love with this!

recipes.title: Baked Cream Corn
recipes.description: In this family recipe, creamed corn is baked with eggs, milk, butter and spices. Play with the spice and sugar measurements to suit your own taste.
recipes.search: baked cream corn dinner side dish southern 2 eggs 2 tablespoons milk 2 (14 ¾ ounce) cans creamed corn 2 tablespoons butter, diced 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour 1 tablespoon white sugar ½ teaspoon black pepper ½ teaspoon celery salt ½ teaspoon onion powder ¼ teaspoon garlic powder
